description: Registry of StackShift protocols. Each entry has a tier that drives install mode selection and is materialized to .stackshift/protocols/<file or dir> during bootstrap. Entries may be a single file (`file`) or a directory (`dir`) — directories are copied recursively. The optional `action` and `doneWhen` fields are injected by the CLI into each workflow step's CLI:PROTOCOLS marker region; only the action / done-when entries for protocols actually installed are emitted. The optional `references` array lists reference files in `references/` that are tied to this protocol — the CLI prunes them from the install destination when the protocol is not installed.

tiers.required: Workflow cannot function correctly without it — violations cause build errors, runtime errors, or schema load failures.
tiers.recommended: Quality and UX — no errors if omitted, but Sanity Studio or author experience suffers noticeably.
tiers.optional: Opt-in systems that introduce their own architecture, dependencies, or directory structure. Only install if the project adopts the system.

protocols.title: Factory Function Pattern
protocols.summary: Required shape for every new field factory. Plain objects, no defineField() wrappers. Wrong shape breaks hideInVariants at runtime.

action.title: Use the factory function pattern for any new field
action.body:
Return a plain object. No `defineField()` / `defineType()` wrappers. Always set `_hideInVariants: hidden && hideInVariants`.

See `.stackshift/protocols/factory-function-pattern.md` for the canonical shape.

doneWhen: New fields follow the factory function pattern
Plain object syntax — no `defineField()` wrappers

protocols.title: Sub-Field Visibility
protocols.summary: Hiding sub-fields within a shared object without duplicate field names. Duplicates cause Sanity to reject the schema on load.

action.title: Never create duplicate field names at the section level
action.body:
If only a specific sub-field of a shared object should be hidden for certain variants, apply `hidden` directly on the sub-field. A duplicate field name at section level causes Sanity to reject the schema on load.

See `.stackshift/protocols/sub-field-visibility.md`.

doneWhen: No duplicate field names at section level (sub-field visibility handled on the sub-field)

protocols.title: Variant Router (index.tsx)
protocols.summary: Rules for the section index.tsx. Missing props interface export breaks the variant file's TypeScript compile. Every entry in `Variants` must use `dynamic()` — built-ins from the package's `dist/` path, customs from local files.

action.title: Honor the variant-router contract in `index.tsx`
action.body:
- Function signature is `{ data }: SectionsProps` — not a custom props type.
- Every field uses `?? undefined`.
- Render `null` when `data?.variant` is absent. **Never** hardcode a fallback.
- The section props interface must be exported from `index.tsx` so the variant file can import it from `"."`.
- Every entry in `Variants` uses `dynamic(() => import(...))`. Built-ins import from `@stackshift-ui/<pkg>/dist/<pkg>_<letter>`; customs from `./variant_<x>`. No star imports.
- When `list.tsx` is switched to a local wrapper, use `.then((m) => m.<Name>)` to match the named export and **drop `{ ssr: false }`**.

See `.stackshift/protocols/variant-router.md` for the full pattern.

doneWhen: Props interface defined and exported from `index.tsx`
Props extracted with `?? undefined` for every field
No hardcoded fallback variant
Every `Variants` entry uses `dynamic()` (built-ins via dist path, customs via `./variant_<x>`)

protocols.title: Variant Naming Convention
protocols.summary: Variant keys follow single-letter sequence (`variant_a` … `variant_z`) before two-letter combinations (`variant_aa`, `variant_ab`, …). The same key must appear in `variantsList[].value`, the `Variants` map, and the variant filename.

action.title: Pick the next variant key correctly — stop and check before typing
action.body:
1. Inspect base-package variants: `grep -E "variant_[a-z]" node_modules/@stackshift-ui/<package>/src/<package>.tsx`.
2. Inspect local custom variants: `ls components/sections/<section>/`.
3. Merge both lists. The next key is the **lowest unused single letter** before any two-letter combination.
4. Two-letter suffixes (`aa`, `ab`, …) begin only after `variant_z` is exhausted.
5. Use the **same string** in `variantsList[].value`, the `Variants` map key, and the variant filename.

See `.stackshift/protocols/variant-naming-convention.md`.

doneWhen: Next variant key is the lowest unused single letter (no two-letter keys while single letters before `z` remain)
Identical key string in `variantsList[].value`, `Variants` map, and `variant_<x>.tsx` filename

protocols.title: Variant Reuse First
protocols.summary: Before scaffolding a new variant, check base-package and local variants. Reuse as-is when fields and layout match; wrap when fields match but layout differs; create new only when fields or structure are genuinely different.

action.title: Run the variant reuse decision tree before Step 4a
action.body:
Three-step decision:
1. Same fields + same layout → use existing variant in Studio. **No new file.** No `variantsList` change.
2. Same fields + different layout → wrap the existing variant via `dynamic(() => import("@stackshift-ui/<pkg>/dist/<pkg>_<letter>"))` and override layout. Keep the existing `value`.
3. Different fields or structurally different → only now scaffold a new variant.

See `.stackshift/protocols/variant-reuse-first.md`.

doneWhen: Base-package and local variants inspected before scaffolding
Reuse decision recorded (use as-is / wrap / scaffold new) with rationale

protocols.title: Dynamic Variants Registry
protocols.summary: Registers custom variants in `components/data/dynamic.ts` so the Studio variant picker live-renders the variant component (instead of the static JPG) when `NEXT_PUBLIC_RENDER_DYNAMIC_COMPONENTS=true`. No-op when the env flag is off.

action.title: Register custom variants in `components/data/dynamic.ts` when live previews are enabled
action.body:
Check `NEXT_PUBLIC_RENDER_DYNAMIC_COMPONENTS` first. If unset / `"false"`, this protocol is a no-op — rely on the static `images/` path from `section-directory-layout`.

When the flag is `"true"`:
- Part A: add a `customXxxVariants[]` array and spread it into `variantsMap[section]`.
- Part B: if the section has a project-local `initialValue/index.ts`, import it and assign it in `initialValuesMap`, replacing the base-package default (remove the now-unused base import).

The `cookies` section is always excluded.

See `.stackshift/protocols/dynamic-variants-registry.md`.

doneWhen: Env-flag decision evaluated (`NEXT_PUBLIC_RENDER_DYNAMIC_COMPONENTS`)
When flag is on: every custom variant has a `customXxxVariants[]` entry spread into `variantsMap`
When flag is on and `initialValue/` is custom: `initialValuesMap` references the project-local value and the base-package import is removed

protocols.title: One-Time Custom Schema Setup
protocols.summary: Project-level setup to enable custom local variants. Without it, custom sections never appear in Studio. Run once per project.

action.title: Verify one-time custom schema setup is complete
action.body: If the project's custom schema merge has not been wired up, follow `.stackshift/protocols/one-time-custom-schema-setup.md` ONCE, then never again. Without this, any new section you add in Step 2 will not appear in Sanity Studio.

doneWhen: One-time custom schema setup has been completed for this project

protocols.title: Field Reuse First
protocols.summary: Check local and base-package field factories before creating any new field. Duplication works but pollutes the schema.

action.title: Reuse existing fields first
action.body: Check the local `fields.ts`, then base package, then dynamic factories before creating anything new. See `.stackshift/protocols/field-reuse-first.md`.

doneWhen: Reuse check performed before creating new fields

protocols.title: Hide If Variant
protocols.summary: Use hideIfVariantIn() to exclude fields from specific variants. Authors otherwise see irrelevant fields — no error, just bad UX.

action.title: Apply `hideIfVariantIn([])` when adding a variant
action.body: Walk every field in `schema/index.ts` and exclude the new variant from any field it does not use. See `.stackshift/protocols/hide-if-variant.md`.

doneWhen: `hideIfVariantIn([])` updated for the new variant on every unused field

protocols.title: Preview Conventions
protocols.summary: Preview blocks for arrays and objects. Image vs icon fallback decision tree. Missing previews don't error — Studio just looks empty.

action.title: Add a `preview` block to every array of objects and every object field
action.body: Image or icon fallback, `prepare()` always returning a non-empty `title`. See `.stackshift/protocols/preview-conventions.md`.

doneWhen: Every new array-of-objects and object field has a `preview` block

protocols.title: Array Layout Conventions
protocols.summary: Grid / tags / collapsible layout options for different array content types. Author UX only.

action.title: Pick the right `options.layout` for arrays
action.body: `grid` for images, `tags` for string arrays, collapsible for navs. See `.stackshift/protocols/array-layout.md`.

doneWhen: Array fields use the appropriate `options.layout`

protocols.title: Section Directory Layout
protocols.summary: initialValue/ placeholder content for every variant and images/ thumbnails as the static branch of variant-preview. images/ is the default; when `NEXT_PUBLIC_RENDER_DYNAMIC_COMPONENTS=true`, prefer `dynamic-variants-registry` instead.

action.title: Populate `initialValue/` and (when applicable) `images/`
action.body:
- Populate `initialValue/` with placeholder content for every variant. Empty forms are a poor author experience.
- For the variant picker thumbnail, pick **one** path based on `NEXT_PUBLIC_RENDER_DYNAMIC_COMPONENTS`:
  - Env unset or `"false"` → populate `images/` with one 800×600 JPG per variant, named to match the variant's `value`.
  - Env `"true"` → register in `components/data/dynamic.ts` per `dynamic-variants-registry`; the static JPG becomes optional.

See `.stackshift/protocols/section-directory-layout.md`.

doneWhen: `initialValue/` populated for every variant
Variant picker preview path chosen based on `NEXT_PUBLIC_RENDER_DYNAMIC_COMPONENTS` (static JPG via `images/` OR dynamic registration via `dynamic-variants-registry`)

protocols.title: Accessibility
protocols.summary: WCAG 2.1 AA enforcement. When installed, UI Forge generates variants with semantic HTML, accessible names, focus visibility, and reduced-motion handling.

action.title: Require the A11Y FORGE NOTES sub-block
action.body: When invoking `ui-forge`, accessibility rules apply automatically (the bridged `_paired.a11yRequired` flag). After generation, confirm the FORGE NOTES header contains an `A11Y` sub-block. See `.stackshift/protocols/accessibility.md`.

doneWhen: `// FORGE NOTES` header contains an `A11Y` sub-block

protocols.title: Brand
protocols.summary: Registers a project brand document so UI Forge applies voice, palette, typography, and imagery rules during variant generation.

action.title: Require the BRAND FORGE NOTES sub-block
action.body: UI Forge consumes `design/standards/brand.md` automatically via the `designStandards.brand` pointer. After generation, confirm the FORGE NOTES header contains a `BRAND` sub-block. See `.stackshift/protocols/brand.md`.

doneWhen: `// FORGE NOTES` header contains a `BRAND` sub-block

protocols.title: Paired-Mode Contract
protocols.summary: Canonical handshake doc between StackShift and UI Forge — skill-root resolution, marker fields, flag refusal matrix, modifier composition, contract version dance.

action.title: Honor the paired-mode contract when invoking `ui-forge`
action.body:
UI Forge refuses these flags in paired mode: `--creative`, `--diff`, `--preview`. The contract-first handoff and these modes are mutually exclusive by design. For iterative regeneration of a completed variant, run UI Forge standalone with `--diff` outside the StackShift workflow.

See `.stackshift/protocols/paired-mode-contract.md` for the full refusal matrix, modifier composition rules, marker fields, and the contract version handshake.

doneWhen: No paired-mode-refused flags passed to `ui-forge` (`--creative`, `--diff`, `--preview`)

protocols.title: Claude Design Handoff
protocols.summary: Allows Step 4 variants to be generated from a Claude Design handoff URL via UI Forge's --handoff flag and the round-trip workflow. Requires UI Forge ≥ 0.1.9.

action.title: Require the CLAUDE_DESIGN FORGE NOTES sub-block when `--handoff` is used
action.body: When the variant is generated from a Claude Design handoff URL via UI Forge's `--handoff` flag, confirm the FORGE NOTES header contains a `CLAUDE_DESIGN` sub-block documenting source URL, task summary, and token remappings. No tokens from the handoff may appear inline in the generated TSX. See `.stackshift/protocols/claude-design-handoff.md`.

doneWhen: When `--handoff` was used: FORGE NOTES contains a `CLAUDE_DESIGN` sub-block
When `--handoff` was used: No tokens from the handoff appear inline in the generated TSX (every color/spacing value resolves to a `design-arch.json` token name)

protocols.title: Auto-Verify Hook (PostToolUse)
protocols.summary: Installs a Claude Code PostToolUse hook that runs UI Forge's verify.js on every variant write. Requires UI Forge ≥ 0.1.9.

action.title: Use the PostToolUse hook for structural postconditions
action.body: The PostToolUse hook fires automatically on the variant write and runs UI Forge's `verify.js` (which delegates to `validate.js` from `@extragraj/variant-contract`). The structural postcondition becomes "hook exit code 0" — no separate command. The manual `validate-contract.js` invocation remains valid as a backup. See `.stackshift/protocols/auto-verify-hook.md`.

doneWhen: Auto-verify-hook exit code is 0 on the most recent variant write

protocols.title: Auto-Validate Hook (PostToolUse)
protocols.summary: Installs a Claude Code PostToolUse hook that runs `stackshift-skills validate` on every Write/Edit. Statically enforces factory-function-pattern, sub-field-visibility, variant-router, variant-naming-convention, and preview-conventions invariants on schema and section-router writes.

protocols.title: Modal & Sheet
protocols.summary: Standalone modal documents linked via conditionalLink. Editors pick a modal ref; clicking opens a @stackshift-ui/sheet or @stackshift-ui/dialog overlay instead of navigating. One-time setup + per-variant workflow with UI Forge delegation.
